This isn’t just another Cursor Philly meetup. We’re turning one. 🎂
A year ago, Cursor Philly started with a simple idea: get people in a room, spread the word about what Cursor was making possible, and see what everyone was building.
A lot has changed since then.
Cursor has become one of the biggest names in AI coding. And here in Philly, that first meetup turned into packed rooms, new projects, friendships, and a community that keeps getting bigger. 🧡
Whether you’ve been here since the beginning or this is your first Cursor Philly event, come hang out with the community and celebrate one…

Hosted by Luis Cielak & Malcolm Jones
